en: Black-and-white historical postcard showing a busy industrial harbor with multiple large sailing ships and steamships moored along the quayside. In the foreground are several railway tracks, freight cars, and piles of ore or coal. Small industrial buildings and cranes are visible, with water and ships in the background. The layout and printing style are typical of an early 20th‑century postcard.
